# WO-635: Cloudflare "Verify you are human" fails inside the fill window
Status: GO (start after WO-634; same files)
Vendor: claude
Agent: automation-engineer, then qa-security (review)
Kind: engine
Tier: deep
Severity: HIGH
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.3.2
Source: field report docs/feedback/2026-11-13-windows-family-test.md (F6).
Boundary: docs/EVIDENCE_ENGINE.md and shared rule 5. No evasion in any form: no stealth plugins, no hiding navigator.webdriver, no fingerprint changes, no CAPTCHA solving services. A challenge the site will not pass is handed to the person.

## Task
1. Confirm the CAPTCHA widget hosts load in the headed fill window (`allow_captcha_frames`, `netpolicy.captcha_hosts`): check that every Turnstile sub-resource and the site's own `/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/` requests are allowed. A blocked Turnstile request is our bug and gets fixed.
2. If everything loads and Turnstile still fails, treat it as the site refusing automated browsers: detect the Turnstile failure state, and switch to the hand-off. The banner says, in plain words, "This site's 'are you human' check doesn't work in our helper window. Click 'Open in my browser' and we'll show you what to type." Open the opt-out page in the person's default browser and show the planned values in the app with copy buttons (Assisted tier).
3. Record the event as evidence (obstruction kind per EVIDENCE_ENGINE.md), reason code only.

## Acceptance
- Tests with a fixture page that mimics a failed Turnstile widget state; the hand-off fires and the card is kept.
- Grep proof that no evasion code was added. qa-security review.
